Container.Name: wine-tracker
Container.Overview: A tiny wine cellar tracker. Log the bottles you win, see what's in stock, and mark them drank with the date. Keeps a running history of everything you've had. Stores everything in a local SQLite file (map the /data path to persist it) — no external database needed.
Container.Description: A simple, mobile-first wine tracker with a web dashboard. Add wines by name and year, track the date you won each bottle, and mark bottles as drunk (with a date) to move them into your history. Two views: the active Cellar (what you currently have in stock) and History (everything you've drunk). Includes search and a duplicate warning so you don't double-add. All data lives in a single SQLite file under /data — back that path up and your cellar is safe across reboots and updates.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Wine Tracker web app

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where the SQLite database (wine.db) is stored. Keep this on persistent storage.
